headline: Bio-based and advanced materials: incumbents are restructuring and trimming risky textile bets while EU and Finnish support and small start-up rounds continue, and no new major deals surfaced this week.

signals.title: Stora Enso keeps Central European sawmills and building solutions
signals.detail: Strategic review concluded; the business stays in the group. Read from search summaries of the release.

signals.title: Spinnova signs non-binding LOI with Outlast
signals.detail: Spinnova fibre for insulation and temperature-regulating textiles. A US IPO of at least USD 15 million was still unconfirmed in searches on 2026-11-19: no pricing or closing found.

signals.title: altM (India) raises USD 10.3 million Series A for bio-based specialty chemicals
signals.detail: Shows investor appetite for bio-based chemicals outside Europe.

signals.title: Stora Enso board approves demerger plan for Swedish forest assets
signals.detail: EGM expected 2026-12-15; listing on Nasdaq Stockholm and Helsinki reported for March 2027.

signals.title: WISA Group (former UPM Plywood) listed on Nasdaq Helsinki
signals.detail: Demerger registered 2026-10-31; trading was due to start 2026-11-02.

signals.title: Metsä Group Q3: earnings recover, comparable EBITDA EUR 100 million
signals.detail: Sales EUR 1,267 million; Jan–Sep comparable EBITDA EUR 357 million. Softwood pulp demand expected to stay subdued.

signals.title: Stora Enso Q3: forest demerger plan and packaging focus
signals.detail: Adjusted EBIT rose 28 % to EUR 161 million but missed forecasts. The board approved separating Swedish forest assets into a new listed company (Bergslagets Skogar), expected in H1 2027. Biomaterials profit rose on higher prices.

signals.title: UPM Q3: strong cash flow amid destocking and cost inflation
signals.detail: Comparable EBIT EUR 141 million vs 153 million a year earlier. Biofuels and energy carried results, which shows weak demand in the graphic and fibre businesses.

signals.title: Kemira Q3: revenue up on acquisitions, margins hit by raw-material costs
signals.detail: Revenue EUR 708.9 million, flat excluding acquisitions; FY2026 guidance kept.

signals.title: Horizon Europe bridging calls open
signals.detail: HORIZON-BRIDGING-2027-02-05 has EUR 32.5 million for about 13 grants. It funds follow-on innovation from completed Pillar II projects, with a maximum of 6 partners. Deadline 2027-01-28.

signals.title: Horizon Europe bridging and advanced-materials calls open
signals.detail: Calls on circular advanced materials (MAT-PROD-06) and on valorising project results opened in October 2026. Both suit university commercialisation.

signals.title: UPM inaugurates Leuna wood-to-chemicals biorefinery
signals.detail: 220,000 t a year; creates European supply of lignin-based fillers and bio-glycols.

signals.title: Spinnova shareholders approve dual-listing plan; US IPO not confirmed completed
signals.detail: Spinnova has publicly filed an F-1 targeting at least USD 15 million on Nasdaq Capital Market, and reported a EUR 1.5 million bridge financing in early October. I found no report that the IPO has priced or closed.

signals.title: LignoSphere (Aalto spin-off) extends pre-seed round with TekVentures
signals.detail: Espoo-based LignoSphere turns kraft lignin into colloidal particles for adhesives and coatings. Teknor Apex's TekVentures joined the round; Kiilto Ventures and Stephen Industries invested earlier in 2026; Business Finland provided a product-development loan until June 2027. External funding in 2026 totals just over EUR 1.2 million.

signals.title: Spinnova files SEC registration for US IPO
signals.detail: Spinnova plans a Nasdaq Capital Market dual listing raising at least USD 15 million, against a market cap of about EUR 27 million. The offering was expected in Sep–Oct 2026. I found no confirmation that it was completed.
